Shop Dave’s Garage 910 Comments Sort comments Sort by Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Add a comment... @Chris-hf2sl 9 months ago I'm a retired electronic engineer, who spent a whole career designing, programming and using computers. I've watched many videos on quantum computers and am still none the wiser on how they actually work. All the videos cover the same basic principles - qubits, superposition, entanglement, being all states at once etc. BUT none explain how to program them or how they execute algorithms. I'm in the same position as a complete layman who is trying to understand how conventional computers work, only to be repeatedly told "they use bits that can be 0 or 1, which are processed by logic gates and which in large numbers can represent anything". Yes, but how do they actually work? Also, Fun fact here: while the observer will know the state of the other particle by observing the primary - regardless of the distance - the communication of that knowledge cannot be communicated to another actor faster than the speed of light. This is why the "spooky action at a distance" doesn't break general relativity.
